input.effect_key: ASCII ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$ and at most 128 UTF-8 bytes

parser.input: one UTF-8 JSON value with no BOM or trailing content
parser.integer_policy: canonical safe integers only; decimal, exponent, negative zero, and unsafe values reject
parser.duplicate_member_policy: each member value is parsed before duplicate decoded-key detection
parser.depth_policy: container entry is bounded before recursive descent
parser.unicode_policy: decoded strings are checked for Unicode scalar validity after parsing

closed_precedence: root unknown fields before missing fields
root field types profile then declarations
declarations in input order: object, unknown before missing, effect_key type then effect_digest type, key byte length then key grammar, digest grammar

output.ordering: groups ASCII-sort by effect_key; digest entries ASCII-sort by effect_digest

invariants: identical declarations are valid and counted
effect_key and effect_digest equality are exact ASCII sequence equality
the digest is never recomputed, interpreted, or trusted as content or provenance
the evaluator has no side effects
non_claims: no exactly-once behavior, replay protection, replay store, deletion, suppression, application, selection, or winner
no ordering, mutation, persistence, delivery, retry, envelope, receipt, or operation-state behavior
no revision, lifecycle, authority, policy, identity, authentication, authorization, trust, provenance, digest verification, or content binding
no filesystem, artifact, execution, runtime, provider, integration, deployment, publication, or interoperability claim
